arxiv-2303-03458.title: Learning Differential Invariants of Planar Curves
arxiv-2303-03458.creator: Roy Velich, Ron Kimmel
arxiv-2303-03458.description: Abstract We propose a learning paradigm for the numerical approximation of differential invariants of planar curves. Deep neural-networks’ (DNNs) universal approximation properties are utilized to estimate geometric measures. The proposed framework is shown to be a preferable alternative to axiomatic constructions.

arxiv-2305-11806.title: The Inside Story: Towards Better Understanding of Machine Translation Neural Evaluation Metrics
arxiv-2305-11806.creator: Ricardo Rei, Nuno M. Guerreiro, Marcos Treviso, Alon Lavie, Luisa Coheur, André F. T. Martins
arxiv-2305-11806.description: Abstract Neural metrics for machine translation evaluation, such as Comet , exhibit significant improvements in their correlation with human judgments compared to traditional metrics based on lexical overlap, such as Bleu . Yet neural metrics are, to a great extent, “black boxes” that return a single sentence-level score without transparency about the decision-making process.

arxiv-2310-05690.title: Abstractive Summarization of Large Document Collections Using GPT
arxiv-2310-05690.creator: Shengjie Liu, Christopher G. Healey
arxiv-2310-05690.description: Abstract This paper proposes a method of abstractive summarization designed to scale to document collections instead of individual documents. Our approach applies a combination of semantic clustering, document size reduction within topic clusters, semantic chunking of a cluster’s documents, GPT-based summarization and concatenation, and a combined sentiment and text visualization of each topic to support exploratory data analysis.

arxiv-2502-10578.title: Implicit vs. explicit regularization for high-dimensional gradient descent
arxiv-2502-10578.creator: Thomas Stark and Lukas Steinberger University of Vienna
arxiv-2502-10578.description: Abstract In this paper we investigate the generalization error of gradient descent (GD) applied to an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -regularized OLS objective function in the linear model. Based on our analysis we develop new methodology for computationally tractable and statistically efficient linear prediction in a high-dimensional and massive data scenario (large- n n , large- p p ).

arxiv-2511-21291.title: Illuminating the Black Box: Real-Time Monitoring of Backdoor Unlearning in CNNs via Explainable AI
arxiv-2511-21291.creator: Hoang Tien Dat
arxiv-2511-21291.description: Abstract Backdoor attacks pose severe security threats to deep neural networks by embedding malicious triggers that force misclassification. While machine unlearning techniques can remove backdoor behaviors, current methods lack transparency and real-time interpretability. This paper introduces a novel framework that integrates Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) into the unlearning process to provide real-time monitoring and explainability.

uslaw-usc-t8-s1301.title: 8 U.S.C. § 1301 — Alien seeking entry; contents
uslaw-usc-t8-s1301.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t8-s1301.description: United States Code, Title 8 (Aliens And Nationality); Chapter 12 (Immigration And Nationality); Subchapter II (Immigration); Part VII (Registration Of Aliens). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. No visa shall be issued to any alien seeking to enter the United States until such alien has been registered in accordance with section 1201(b) of this title.
